description: This file defines the 'BuzzFeedPostModel' class, a PHP class implementing the 'Normalizable' interface. It serves as a model for representing various types of social media posts (text, photo, video, share) in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin API. The class encapsulates a 'BuzzFeedPost' DTO and provides a 'toArray()' method that serializes the post data into an associative array, including details such as post ID, type, likes, content, employee info, stats, creation date/time, media links, and permissions.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPostModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing BuzzFeedPost DTOs into array format for API responses, supporting multiple post types.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the encapsulated BuzzFeedPost DTO into an associative array, including media and permission details based on the post type.
